```
252	          paint(cx, cy + 1);

254	          paint(cx + 1, cy + 1);

256	          paint(cx - 1, cy + 1);
257	          paint(cx - 1, cy - 1);
258	          paint(cx, cy); // useInterior

276	export function runJungleMudWallsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
277	  const bandY = Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 20;   // j < worldSurface+20.0
278	  let minX = 0, maxX = 0;
279	  let flag = false;
280	  for (let i = 5; i < st.w - 5; i++) {
281	    for (let j = 0; j < bandY; j++) {
282	      if (st.flags[st.idx(i, j)] && st.type[st.idx(i, j)] === JUNGLE_GRASS) {
283	        minX = i; flag = true; break;
284	      }
285	    }
286	    if (flag) break;
287	  }
288	  flag = false;
289	  for (let i = st.w - 5; i > 5; i--) {
290	    for (let j = 0; j < bandY; j++) {
291	      if (st.flags[st.idx(i, j)] && st.type[st.idx(i, j)] === JUNGLE_GRASS) {
292	        maxX = i; flag = true; break;
293	      }
294	    }
295	    if (flag) break;
296	  }
297	  for (let l = minX; l <= maxX; l++) {
298	    for (let m = 0; m < bandY; m++) {
299	      const wi = st.idx(l, m);
300	      // 边缘带逐格掷骰（&& 左求值：内带 0 掷）
301	      if (((l >= minX + 2 && l <= maxX - 2) || rng.nextInt(2) !== 0)
302	        && ((l >= minX + 3 && l <= maxX - 3) || rng.nextInt(3) !== 0)
303	        && (st.wall[wi] === 2 || st.wall[wi] === 59)) {
304	        st.wall[wi] = 15;
305	      }
306	    }
307	  }
308	}
```

```
9	{
10		private int _maximumActions;
11	
12		public ShapeFloodFill(int maximumActions = 100)
13		{
14			_maximumActions = maximumActions;
15		}
16	
17		public override bool Perform(Point origin, GenAction action)
18		{
19			Queue<Point> queue = new Queue<Point>();
20			HashSet<Point16> hashSet = new HashSet<Point16>();
21			queue.Enqueue(origin);
22			int num = _maximumActions;
23			while (queue.Count > 0 && num > 0)
24			{
25				Point point = queue.Dequeue();
26				if (!hashSet.Contains(new Point16(point.X, point.Y)) && UnitApply(action, origin, point.X, point.Y))
27				{
28					hashSet.Add(new Point16(point));
29					num--;
30					if (point.X + 1 < Main.maxTilesX - 1)
31					{
32						queue.Enqueue(new Point(point.X + 1, point.Y));
33					}
34					if (point.X - 1 >= 1)
35					{
36						queue.Enqueue(new Point(point.X - 1, point.Y));
37					}
38					if (point.Y + 1 < Main.maxTilesY - 1)
39					{
40						queue.Enqueue(new Point(point.X, point.Y + 1));
41					}
42					if (point.Y - 1 >= 1)
43					{
44						queue.Enqueue(new Point(point.X, point.Y - 1));
45					}
46				}
47			}
48			while (queue.Count > 0)
49			{
50				Point item = queue.Dequeue();
51				if (!hashSet.Contains(new Point16(item.X, item.Y)))
52				{
53					queue.Enqueue(item);
54					break;
55				}
56			}
57			return queue.Count == 0;
58		}
59	}
```

````
Critical detail found in ShapeFloodFill.Perform:

```csharp
while (queue.Count > 0 && num > 0)

Key points:
1. `UnitApply(action, origin, x, y)` — returns whether the FULL action chain succeeded. If IsNotSolid fails → UnitApply returns false → the point is NOT added to hashSet, num NOT decremented, neighbors NOT enqueued. And it will be retried?? No — it was dequeued. It's just gone (not re-enqueued). Note: it does NOT get added to hashSet, so if another path re-enqueues the same point later, it will be tried again (and fail again).

2. The final purge loop: after the main loop (queue empty or num==0), it dequeues items until it finds one NOT in hashSet — if found, re-enqueues it and breaks → queue.Count>0 → returns false. So the return value = "did we cover everything" = queue contains only already-visited points (or empty).

Subtle: when the main loop exits because num==0 but queue non-empty: purge loop dequeues; points still in queue are the neighbors of the last added point etc. If ALL remaining queue points are in hashSet (possible? points are enqueued only when adding a different point; a point in queue could have been visited later via another route) → dequeue until find non-hashSet point → break with queue.Count>0? Wait if it finds a non-hashSet point it re-enqueues (queue grows by... it dequeued several, then re-enqueues 1 and breaks) → returns false. If it drains the whole queue without finding a non-hashSet point, queue.Count==0 → returns true.

So `flag2` (Gen return) = "all enqueued points were successfully applied (visited)". I.e., flood fill completed without hitting quota (or all remaining were visited).

(a) In C#, a point that fails IsNotSolid is NOT added to hashSet and could be retried if re-enqueued by another cell later. In JS, `continue` without adding to cells → same: can be retried. ✓ equivalent.

(b) The return value: C# = after main loop, check if any non-visited point remains in queue (purge + return queue.Count==0). JS: `complete = !(quota<=0 && queue.length)`. NOT equivalent! C# purges visited points from the queue: if main loop exited with num==0 and queue containing only points already in hashSet (all visited), C# returns TRUE (complete). JS says complete=false. Edge case, minor.

But more importantly (c): the JS `queue.shift()` pattern with `if (cells.has(qi)) continue;` — matches the C# `if (!hashSet.Contains && UnitApply)` gating: neighbor enqueue happens only on success. ✓.

So:
````

```
[Serializable]
public class UnifiedRandom

	public UnifiedRandom()
		: this(Environment.TickCount)
	{
	}

	public UnifiedRandom(int Seed)
	{
		SetSeed(Seed);
	}

	public void SetSeed(int Seed)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < SeedArray.Length; i++)
		{
			SeedArray[i] = 0;
		}
		int num = ((Seed == int.MinValue) ? int.MaxValue : Math.Abs(Seed));

			num3 = num2 - num3;

			}

				if (SeedArray[l] < 0)

				}
			}
		}
		inext = 0u;
	}

	protected double Sample()
	{
		return (double)InternalSample() * 4.656612875245797E-10;
	}

	private int InternalSample()
	{
		uint num = inext + 1;
		if (num > 55)
		{
			num = 1u;
		}
		uint num2 = num + 21;
		if (num2 > 55)

		}

		int num3 = seedArray[num] - seedArray[num2];
		if (num3 == int.MaxValue)
		{
			num3--;
		}
		num3 = (seedArray[num] = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF));
		inext = num;
		return num3;
	}

	public int Peek()
	{
		uint num = inext + 1;
		if (num > 55)

			num = 1u;
		}

		if (num2 > 55)

		}

	}
```
